sample.label: select-immediately-vs-suspend-judgment
sample.rationale: Both name a discipline for handling an unruly, only-partly-controllable generative output — Cameron forbids any judgment or re-reading for weeks; the compositing practice's rule is to select the best take immediately out of many plausible generations. Productive tension on how to treat generative overflow, not a resolved question.
sample.evidence: "take what it gives and select, rather than fight it" / "you don't edit and you don't perform... no re-reading for at least eight weeks."

sample.label: preserve-the-substrate-transform-the-field
sample.rationale: Both name a production discipline where a stable authored core is kept fixed while a technical medium transforms only the surrounding field — dub keeps the riddim and echoes the space; the compositing practice keeps the drawn hero and animates the sky/smoke around him.
sample.evidence: "What you authored... stays crisp... What should breathe... gets real motion." / "Subtraction is composition. The mixing board is the instrument. The engineer plays."

sample.evidence: "The modes do not settle independently; they are coupled via the acoustic boundary." / "the striatum may be part of the biological implementation of the phase-locking dynamics that Kuramoto describes mathematically."

sample.rationale: Both refuse a discrete-state-plus-interpolation model of process in favor of continuous, embodied trajectory as the primary reality — motion isn't computed toward a target, it IS the target-seeking.
sample.evidence: "The glide does not happen to the pitch. The pitch IS the glide. Every moment of the trajectory is a moment of physical settling. Listen to where the voice overshoots; that is where the body is alive." || "The hand reaching for the cup does not first form a mental representation and then execute it; the reaching IS a form of intentionality in its own right... There is a knowing-how that is not a watered-down knowing-that."

sample.rationale: Both entries, independently, reach for the same coupled-oscillator/phase-locking vocabulary to explain a domain that has no obvious a priori reason to be described that way — vibrating string/vocal-fold modes on one side, basal ganglia timing circuits on the other.
